description: How active and invested is this person in the Ethos reputation network? Total XP earned across all seasons for a userkey (address, X handle or id, Discord or Telegram id, or profile id). XP accrues from reviews, vouches, invitations and other contributions, so it separates long-standing, engaged members from fresh or dormant accounts. Use it alongside the credibility score to weigh how much history stands behind a reputation. Free, no payment or key; the same answer as the free Ethos API. Example input: {"userkey":"profileId:1"}. Example output: 4076702

userkey.description: An Ethos userkey: address:0x… (EVM address), profileId:<n>, service:x.com:<X account id>, service:x.com:username:<X handle>, service:discord:<id> or service:telegram:<id>.

name: ethos_xp
title: Total XP for a userkey
